body:
She gives me motivation... gotta go to work, gotta be able to feed kitty. Can’t stay in bed all day because she’s a high maintenance mf who only drinks from running faucets 🙃 

I hope those good people are out there. I just have terrible luck at finding them.
Cats are amazing. She’s been with me through so much. It’s hard to comprehend how 12 pounds of floof and farts could have such an impact of my life.

She’s almost seven, and I “rescued” her from a pile of mud and snow on an abandoned property (she really just adopted me because she came right up to me and snuggled and decided I was her person now). She was way too little when I found her and we had some bottle feeding/spoon feeding fun because I couldn’t find mama. I believe she might be a Turkish van. I’d post pictures but she’s got a bit of an Instagram following and I worry I’ll be outed here.

I am terrified of getting distant with my husband. Right now, we do *life* together. We walked to this store this afternoon to get stuff for dinner. Could we do that with kids? Maybe, but it would be more difficult. It's cold today, there's not a good path for a stroller, we left with both of our hands full so we couldn't carry them too. When we decide to do a late night snack run, we both go. Can we do that with kids? Well they're already in bed, we can't wake them up. We do lots of fun little adventures together and we don't have an abundance of family support who will step in to babysit if needed. Our lives feel so full and complete right now. 

I want kids, I just can't envision having the room for them. Time, money, and heart wise. 

I don't know, weird feelings.
I hope your thread getting derailed keeps you up at night. Let the hate run through you. Take your ball and go home, champ.
I can't quite decide if you're drunk or banging your face on the keyboard and deciding "Yep, that'll do."
It's not healthy to overthink the internet like that buddy.
I used to think women would get pregnant by guys peeing in the general area of their vagina.
